newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK NATL MORTGAGE BANK TO CUT LOAN RATES DEC 16.
newsitem.headline: GREEK NATL MORTGAGE BANK TO CUT LOAN RATES DEC 16.

text.p: Greece's state National Mortgage Bank cut its three-and six-year mortgage rates by half a point to 14.50 percent and 15 percent respectively, effective December 16, it said in a statement.
It also slashed its 10, 15 and 20-year fixed rate mortgages to 15.50 percent from 16 percent and its 10, 15 and 20-year adjustable mortgages to 17 percent from 17.25 percent, it said.
It also trimmed its other mortgage rates by 25 to 50 basis points. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
